title: Dispatch: restrict returned basis to lost custody (attempt 1)
description:
Works defect bead eshyra-4ygd (read it first: full analysis with file/line refs). Parent spec: eshyra-f0nz (acceptance criterion 1 and the supervisor design decision — follow it, not the bead's original 'sale-reversed' sketch).

Branch/worktree: this bead's id, cut from eshyra-f0nz.

## Code survey (verified 2026-07-19)

- `packages/core/src/state/domainMutations.ts` `reacquireItem` (~line 613): compatibility gate at ~667-673 rejects only sold+found and lost+repurchased; payment required for repurchased, forbidden otherwise (~628-635).
- `listRecoverableItems` (~line 440-465): maps basis → eligible dispositions; today 'returned' includes sold rows. 
- `packages/core/src/orchestrator/toolReacquireItem.ts`: tool schema (basis enum, payment description) and tool description text mention returned as valid generally.
- Selling records NO wallet linkage (`removeItem` performs no currency mutation), so a refund cannot be computed deterministically — this is why the fix below restricts basis rather than adding a sale-reversed transition.
- The `inventory_custody_event` CHECK `(basis='repurchased') = (payment_event_id IS NOT NULL)` is untouched; historical sold+returned events remain valid append-only history. NO migration in this dispatch.

## Required behavior change

- `reacquireItem`: 'returned' becomes valid only for `unheld_disposition='lost'`. Extend the compatibility gate so sold+returned throws with a message that names 'repurchased' (with atomic payment) as the only sold-row recovery path.
- `listRecoverableItems`: basis 'returned' discovers only lost rows.
- `toolReacquireItem.ts`: update the basis/payment descriptions and tool description so the model is told sold rows require repurchased+payment and returned applies to lost property only.
- Grep for existing tests pinning the payment-free sold-item return (evidence text like "rescinded the sale") — rewrite them to assert the new rejection, and keep/extend coverage that lost+returned still succeeds and sold+repurchased still debits atomically. This is a deliberate spec change, not test weakening; reference eshyra-4ygd in the updated test names/comments where the old behavior was pinned.

## Tests

- sold + returned → MutateStateError (both domain-level and via the tool if a tool-level test exists).
- lost + returned → succeeds, no wallet change.
- sold + repurchased with payment → succeeds, wallet debited, payment event recorded (existing coverage; keep).
- list_recoverable_items with basis 'returned' excludes sold rows; 'repurchased' still finds them.

## Verification

`npm ci` first, then `npm run verify:worktree` from this worktree. Commit on this branch only.
notes: Completed eshyra-lbda. Updated reacquire/list tool schemas and descriptions plus the system protocol. Reworked regression coverage for sold+returned rejection, lost+returned success, returned discovery filtering, and preserved atomic repurchase coverage.
